title: Federal Prosecutors Say This Sioux Falls Crypto Investor Ran a $20 Million Fraud
summary: A federal grand jury indicted Sioux Falls crypto investor Benjamin Paul Wiener, 43, on 29 counts tied to an alleged fraud scheme that prosecutors estimate cost victims roughly $20 million. The charges include wire fraud, money laundering, bank fraud, and aggravated identity theft.
